Class CardLoader

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.data.CardLoader
public final class CardLoader extends Object
Facade for loading card and noble data into the game. Provides a simple static API for CSV-based card and noble loading with fail-fast validation.

  • Method Details

    • loadCards

      public static List<Card> loadCards(int tier)
      Loads all cards for a specific tier. This method uses the configured CsvCardParser to load cards. If no provider is configured, it creates a default CSV parser.
      Parameters:
      tier - The card tier to load (1, 2, or 3)
      Returns:
      List of cards for the specified tier, shuffled
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if data cannot be loaded

    • loadNobles

      public static List<Noble> loadNobles()
      Loads all available noble tiles. This method uses the configured CsvCardParser to load nobles. If no provider is configured, it creates a default CSV parser.
      Returns:
      List of noble tiles, shuffled
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if data cannot be loaded
